docs.description: OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible HTTP API for Cherry Studio, plus Cherry-specific endpoints (models, knowledge bases)

operations.admin_create_agent: Create an agent (managed admin route, M0-4). Body follows the official CreateAgentCommand schema (name/type/model/instructions/configuration/tools/skills). Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key, NOT the employee api_key).
operations.admin_create_provider: Create a provider (managed admin route, M0-1②/M0-4). Body follows the official CreateProviderDto. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_list_providers: List providers (managed admin route, M0-1②). Optional `?enabled=true|false` filter. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_read_usage: Read model + token usage from the local `ai_usage_record` table (managed admin route, M0-5). Supports `?from=` / `?to=` numeric timestamp window filters; returns the full official record fields. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_replace_provider_api_keys: Replace a provider's stored API keys (managed admin route, M0-1③). Body: `{ "keys": ApiKeyEntry[] }`. Only updates the employee-side provider key field; relay-side revocation is an operator action. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_update_agent: Update an agent's name and/or instructions (managed admin route, M0-1). Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_update_provider: Update a provider (managed admin route, M0-1②/M0-4). Body follows the official UpdateProviderDto. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.chat_completions: Create a chat completion. Request and response bodies follow the OpenAI Chat Completions format; set `stream: true` for incremental output.
operations.count_tokens: Estimate how many input tokens a set of Anthropic-format messages uses.
operations.generate_content: Generate content through Gemini's `generateContent` method. Request and response bodies follow the Gemini API format; `streamGenerateContent` is served on the same path.
operations.get_knowledge_base: Fetch a single knowledge base by ID.
operations.get_mcp_server: Get an MCP server's details and its tool list.
operations.health: Service health, current time and version. No authentication required.
operations.info: API name, version and the main endpoints. No authentication required.
operations.list_knowledge_bases: List the knowledge bases available in this Cherry Studio instance.
operations.list_mcp_servers: List the MCP servers enabled in Cherry Studio, each with the URL to connect to it.
operations.list_models: List the models available through this gateway, in the OpenAI models format.
operations.mcp_proxy: Model Context Protocol endpoint for an MCP server (Streamable HTTP). Point any MCP client at this URL to use the server through Cherry Studio.
operations.messages: Create a message. Request and response bodies follow the Anthropic Messages format; set `stream: true` for incremental output.
operations.responses: Create a response. Request and response bodies follow the OpenAI Responses format.
operations.search_knowledge_bases: Search one or more knowledge bases and return the matching document chunks.
operations.admin_list_agents: List agents (managed admin route, F-4). Read-only. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_get_agent: Get a single agent by id (managed admin route, F-4). Read-only. Returns 404 when the agent does not exist. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_delete_agent: Delete an agent (managed admin route, F-4). Broadcasts the change so renderer useDataChange subscriptions refetch. Returns 404 when the agent does not exist. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_reorder_agents: Batch reorder agents (managed admin route, F-4). Body follows the official OrderBatchRequest. Persists orderKey and broadcasts the `/agents` projection. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_delete_provider: Delete a provider (managed admin route, F-5). Broadcasts the change so renderer useDataChange subscriptions refetch. Throws notFound (404) when absent; throws invalidOperation for managed providers. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_batch_upsert_providers: Batch create or update providers (managed admin route, F-5). Body is an array of official CreateProviderDto. Broadcasts the `/providers` projection. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_add_provider_api_key: Append a single API key to a provider (managed admin route, F-5). Body: `{ "key": string, "label"?: string }`. Broadcasts list + detail + api-keys surfaces. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_list_skills: List installed global skills (managed admin route, F-6). Read-only. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_list_mcp_servers: List MCP servers (managed admin route, F-6). Read-only. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_get_mcp_server: Get a single MCP server by id (managed admin route, F-6). Read-only. Returns 404 when the MCP server does not exist. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).
operations.admin_list_agent_files: List agent workspaces / working-directory collection (managed admin route, F-7b). Read-only. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <managed_key>` (the independent managed admin key).

tags.anthropic: Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Point an Anthropic SDK at this gateway's base URL to use them.
tags.cherry: Cherry Studio's own endpoints: knowledge bases, service info and health check.
tags.gemini: Gemini-compatible endpoints, served under `/v1beta` like the upstream API.
tags.openai: OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Point an OpenAI SDK at this gateway's base URL to use them.
